_doc: Pipeline config of the example channel (docs/PIPELINE.md, docs/CHANNEL.md). locations — every place a script may name: kit — a kit drawn by code (a file chapter/kits/<kit>.tsx with an export KIT), null — a stub with a mark. What an episode adds (its places, guest roles, actions) goes to its own file pipeline/parts/<episode>.json, merged into this config on load (docs/PARALLEL.md).

cafe.about: a small corner café: a window, a menu board and an open door in the back wall, a counter across the room

street.about: the street outside the café (no kit yet — drawn as a stub)

MIRA.note: the barista: a ponytail, a rust T-shirt

_doc_extras: extras — roles without a figure: an id with the prefix in ON SCREEN (EXTRA_CUSTOMER) or the first of the words found in a line ('a customer'); they are drawn as stand-ins with a stub tag.
_doc_timing: est_syllables_per_sec — speech rate for --estimate (no TTS): letters and digits per second (about 14 for English letters, 4.6 for Korean syllables).
